interpretation: The original Compositae1061 HybPiper reference contains 1061 loci represented by up to three reference taxa.
The 350 nuclear loci reported in Moreyra et al. 2025 are a downstream retained data set, not the full bait/reference locus universe.
R1B-0 must measure locus recovery from the 1061-locus universe before applying a clean-locus/paralogy filter.
claim_boundary: This audit describes the public reference FASTA only; it does not reproduce the Moreyra C. tioganum-augmented intermediate target file.
